overall_summary: The performance data is extremely small and views across all videos are very low (5 to 15 views), indicating that confidence is currently low. The channel needs controlled exploration across core emotional topics like 'अधूरी मोहब्बत' and 'ओवरथिंकिंग' to establish an algorithmic baseline.

winning_patterns.pattern: Relatable digital/phone relics of past relationships
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' (topic: एकतरफा प्यार) and 'पुराना नंबर और अधूरा रिश्ता' (topic: रिश्ते) performed slightly better relatively among the low sample.
winning_patterns.action: Continue leveraging modern smartphone-era break-up micro-habits as focal points.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic mixed-language titles and broad thematic hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos with broad titles like 'Dil Ki Diary: Bewafai Ka Dard' received low views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic English-Hindi mix titles; focus purely on deeply personal, raw Hindi conversational hooks.
